name: WhisperX
description: WhisperX ASR Service: Automatic Speech Recognition with Word-Level Timestamps and Speaker Diarization. OpenAI-compatible endpoints (/v1/audio/transcriptions), speaker diarization, and model caching for a fully local transcription pipeline. On CPU hosts (Intel-only GPU) it runs in DEVICE=cpu mode with float32/int8; on NVIDIA hosts set DEVICE=cuda + COMPUTE_TYPE=float16.

paths.name: Cache Dir
paths.description: Persistent cache for WhisperX ASR + pyannote diarization models (enables offline use once downloaded).

paths.name: Jobs Dir
paths.description: Per-request working files (uploaded + decoded audio). Use a volume with free space for long media.

variables.name: HF Token (diarization)
variables.description: Hugging Face read token (hf_...). REQUIRED for speaker diarization. Must accept agreements for pyannote/speaker-diarization-community-1, pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1, pyannote/segmentation-3.0.

variables.name: Device
variables.description: cuda (NVIDIA GPU) or cpu. This host has no NVIDIA GPU -> cpu.

variables.name: Compute Type
variables.description: float16 (GPU), float32 (CPU), int8 (CPU, lower quality but faster).

variables.name: Batch Size
variables.description: Larger = faster but more memory. Default 16 on cuda, 2 on cpu.

variables.name: Preload Model
variables.description: Model to load at startup (large-v3, small, medium, turbo, ...). Use 'small' on CPU hosts for reasonable speed.

variables.name: Max File Size (MB)
variables.description: Reject larger uploads to prevent OOM. Lower for small-memory hosts.
